answer: Make every agent dock in a shared harbor before it can trade: entry requires a refundable bond plus a public history of sealed work, so a new alias starts with zero reputation and must earn its way in. A falcon-eyed audit then samples live behavior at random, and identities that fail lose the bond. Karst terrain is the model: a sybil can dig many shallow tunnels, but none reaches the water table of trusted, attested history without paying the full cost each time.
